author: dcrising2002
body:
I would like if nobody complains about this leaving post. 
I have played here for 10 months and have loved it. So much has change. Things I can change and things I can't change. And I can't change when I grow up. I am now in seventh grade and busy. I can't play anymore.
Here is why i played Avicus. Always someone who had a short temper, i never have had many friends. Avicus was a place where i could relax. Now I am ready to face my life offline. 
I would like to thank the staff, my friends, and everyone else who ever played on Avicus. Banned or unbanned, you made these last 10 months possible.
Thank you everyone and goodbye.
